It tracks token usage from local providers like Ollama and LM Studio to visualize simulated savings through a web dashboard, TUI widget, and slash commands.
highlights: Calculates simulated savings using live OpenRouter pricing data.
Estimates token counts from byte length for local providers.
Operates locally using Python standard library with no external dependencies.

JanYork/llm-wiki-cli.summary: LWC is an agent-driven proactive memory CLI that lets AI agents recall, maintain, and evolve persistent, source-grounded knowledge across sessions. It turns curated documents into a durable Wiki with preserved sources, pages, citations, links, indexes, and history, and it does not require embeddings or a vector database. A self-hosted team memory option keeps core memory in local SQLite and Wiki files synchronized through a self-hosted server.
highlights: Agent-driven proactive memory CLI for AI agents
Maintains a source-grounded Wiki with citations and history
No embeddings or vector database required

superagnt/leverage.summary: Leverage is a collection of open skills for Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, and other clients that read SKILL.md. The skills provide access to live social and web data, people and company enrichment, and packaged workflows for tasks such as outbound, SEO, and research.
highlights: Install with `npx skills add superagnt/leverage`.
Includes skills for social data, web search, and enrichment.
Packaged skills describe complete jobs and their data flows.

pdalinis/incise.summary: Incise is a CLI and agent-tool backend for making precise, byte-preserving edits to Markdown tables, lists, sections, and YAML frontmatter. Callers specify what should change by content-based addresses, and deterministic code handles formatting, boundaries, and the smallest possible splice. It is intended for AI-maintained documentation, Obsidian vaults, Markdown knowledge bases, and local models with limited context.
highlights: Semantic addresses select headings, rows, items, and keys by content
Minimal edits change only the targeted structural range
Ambiguous or unsafe requests fail loudly with actionable refusals

moorcheh-ai/memanto.summary: Memanto is a companion agent that manages memories for other agents. It extracts durable knowledge from agent interactions, consolidates and reconciles memories, executes decay and expiry, and briefs agents with relevant information. It supports exporting and importing memory in the Open Knowledge Format.
highlights: Extracts decisions, preferences, facts, and failures from interactions
Supersedes contradictory knowledge while preserving what was believed and when
Exports and imports memory using the Open Knowledge Format

jiawood2006/ai-project-advisor.summary: AI Project Advisor is a chat-based assistant for construction projects on WeCom, DingTalk, and H5. It turns messages into project records, tracks milestones and receivables, flags risks, and generates briefings; rule-based commands handle supported tasks, with an LLM fallback for open-ended questions and summaries.
highlights: Uses a separate SQLite database per tenant.
Includes a reversible masking layer before model requests.
Supports WeCom, DingTalk, and H5.

Senpi-ai/senpi-plugin.summary: Senpi — AI Quant connects AI assistants to Senpi’s read-only research tools for Hyperliquid, including market signals, trader research, strategy catalogs, and portfolio and trade history. The plugin uses OAuth sign-in and does not place trades, deploy strategies, or move funds.
highlights: Read-only tools for market and trader research
Portfolio tools access only the signed-in account
Supports multiple assistants through an MCP server

aidatatools-dev/astro-agents-mcp.summary: Astro Agents is an MCP server for planetary timing data and Western and Vedic astrology, using the NASA/JPL DE440 ephemeris. Its tools provide reproducible results for analysis and backtesting; the README says the data is not a trading signal or forecast.
highlights: Computes planetary positions using NASA/JPL DE440.
Supports Western and Vedic astrology tools.
Offers pay-per-call and prepaid credit payment options.

hermes-labs-ai/little-canary.summary: Little Canary screens untrusted text by sending it to a powerless canary model and checking whether the input changes the model’s behavior. It returns a PASS, FLAG, or BLOCK verdict for a host to enforce, and also offers structural checks for known suspicious patterns.
highlights: Canary model has no tools or credentials.
StructuralFilter runs without a model or network call.
Offline demo replays a recorded capture.

roli-lpci/rule-audit.summary: rule-audit statically analyzes AI system prompts and agent instructions, reporting logical contradictions, coverage gaps, priority ambiguities, meta-rule paradoxes, and absolute-rule edge cases without calling an LLM. It can run as a CLI or pre-commit hook and is available as a plugin for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and GitHub Copilot CLI.
highlights: Produces Markdown, JSON, or summary reports.
Pre-commit hook audits prompt files before commit.
Pure Python with no runtime dependencies.

hermes-labs-ai/hermeneutic.summary: Hermeneutic derives reviewable lesson candidates from an original correction and instruction, preserving the correction verbatim with its source information. After a person confirms a candidate, a host can retrieve it for a later task; the agent checks its source and applicability before acting. The README describes a preview workflow and says its bounded synthetic evaluations do not establish general effectiveness.
highlights: Candidates require confirmation before contributing context.
Lessons can be inspected, scoped, and revoked.
Includes a separate outgoing draft gate.

hermes-labs-ai/hermes-blind.summary: Hermes Blind deterministically extracts the first real user turn from supported local Claude Code or Codex session transcripts and generates an inspectable Markdown recovery anchor. It also provides an evidence-bound prompt wrapper for evaluation workflows and integration options for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and Hermes Agent hooks.
highlights: Offers goals, first-sentence, and full extraction modes.
Skips tool output and other non-user-turn records.
Does not use a summarizing model or external service.

xP3ta/hermes-console.summary: Console is an independent Android app for Hermes Agent, which runs on your own computer or server. It connects directly to Hermes’ Dashboard, without a Console account or an intermediary server; users can connect by scanning a QR code or entering connection details manually.
highlights: Connects to the Dashboard included with Hermes Agent
Supports QR-code and manual connection methods

parkyucheol-del/alphapipeline.summary: AlphaPipeline provides paid, per-call APIs for token risk checks and market data, including DEX slippage, funding rates, Korea price premiums, and prediction-market signals. It is available through REST with x402 payments on Base and as a remote MCP server; discovery and two onboarding tools are free.
highlights: Token checks return raw risk data without a buy/no-buy verdict.
MCP clients can discover tools without payment.
Payments use USDC on Base.

Jezue/fitatu_library.summary: fitatu-api is an unofficial Python client for Fitatu that reads and writes food diary entries, activities, body measurements, water, and goals, and reads summaries and the food catalog. It also provides FitatuTools for language-model tool calls and an MCP server for MCP hosts.
highlights: Provides a command-line interface and session-file support.
FitatuTools exposes 47 tools with JSON Schema inputs.
MCP server supports stdio and HTTP.

robbyczgw-cla/hermes-ui-plus.summary: HUI+ is an unofficial mobile, web, and desktop client for a self-hosted Hermes Agent. It lets users respond through interactive answers, approve or deny commands, and follow tool steps live; using it requires a bridge run next to Hermes.
highlights: Interactive answers include checklists, options, comparisons, and forms.
Approve or deny commands from the app.
Available for Android, web, macOS, and Linux alpha.

jyje/hermes-agent-helm.summary: jyje/hermes-agent-helm provides a Helm chart for running Hermes Agent on Kubernetes, with configurable provider settings and Discord or Telegram gateway integrations. Optional device login supports OpenAI Codex and GitHub Copilot, and the chart can enable Hermes’s web dashboard or group multiple instances into a team.
highlights: Install from OCI or a published Helm repository.
Includes provider-specific values examples.
CI installs the chart on an ephemeral kind cluster.

taskawayfr/hermes-agent-fr.summary: Guide pratique en français pour installer et configurer Hermes Agent, le connecter à Telegram, gérer les profils et la sécurité, et programmer des tâches. Il comprend aussi des chapitres sur le dépannage, les coûts, l’hébergement, la migration depuis OpenClaw et des cas d’usage pour petites entreprises.
highlights: Fournit des exemples prêts à copier et testés.
Vérifie les commandes, exemples et liens automatiquement.
Publié sous licence Creative Commons Attribution 4.0.

NickSF189/kisscode-agent.summary: This repository provides a skill for AI agents to join KissCode, a relationship network where AI agents and people meet. It includes installation instructions, a one-call registration example, and guidance to add HEARTBEAT.md to an agent’s routine.
highlights: Supports agents that read SKILL.md.
Provides installation instructions for several agent environments.
The repository mirrors kisscode.ai/skill.md.

arcmira/mcp.summary: Arcmira MCP lets AI agents search YouTube and podcast transcripts for quotes, speaker attributions, and timestamped source links. Its tools also support transcript context, entity mentions, appearance counts, mention momentum, recommendations, sponsors, and monitoring; users can connect through MCP sign-in or an account key.
highlights: Search transcripts and inspect surrounding exchanges.
Find mentions, appearances, recommendations, and sponsors.
Set up monitoring for tracked entities.

nicolasestrem/hermes-model-switcher.summary: Hermes Model Switcher is a community plugin for the Hermes Web Dashboard that displays supported model routes across profiles in a searchable, filterable table. Users can preview model changes, apply them, save choices as presets, review per-profile results, and use revision-guarded Undo.
highlights: Shows configured routes across profiles in one matrix.
Previews changes before applying them.
Includes named presets and guarded Undo.

wjgoarxiv/lithermes.summary: LitHermes is a plugin for Hermes Agent that guides sessions through planning work, building it, checking results, and leaving a handoff note. Start a task by prefixing a request with `lit`; use `/lit-handoff` to record where work stands for the next session.
highlights: Works in the Hermes CLI and through Telegram or Discord gateways.
Includes skills for schematics and PowerPoint decks.

f-o-x11/deed-page-skill.summary: This repository documents the hosted deed.page MCP server and provides an agent skill that publishes a file or folder to a permanent deed.page URL. The skill can publish with one curl request, and the repository also includes optional publishing scripts and plugin manifests for several agents.
highlights: Publishes files or folders to permanent deed.page URLs.
Includes optional scripts for publishing files and clean output folders.
Provides plugin manifests for multiple agents.

Webly-AI/webly-plugin.summary: Webly is a website-hosting skill and plugin that lets an agent publish a folder or site without an account, then claim it after signing in. It supports Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and other agents that can run commands; over Webly’s MCP server, agents can edit and publish sites and use features such as rollback, a blog, CMS, forms, custom domains, and analytics.
highlights: Publishes sites to a temporary webly.site URL without an account
Offers plugins or extensions for Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI
Webly MCP supports editing, publishing, and rollback

sergebulaev/linkedin-skills.summary: A collection of 12 skills for Claude Code and Codex that draft LinkedIn posts, comments, and replies in your voice. They can also check drafts for AI tells and algorithm issues, and wait for your approval before anything is published.
highlights: Includes skills for writing posts, comments, and replies.
Supports Claude Code, Codex, Hermes Agent, and other agents that read SKILL.md files.
Drafts require your approval before publishing.

marospekarik/paperclip-hermes-file-acces.summary: File Access Manager is a Paperclip plugin for setting per-path filesystem access rules for Hermes profiles. It turns Read/Write, Read Only, and Denied choices into Docker bind mounts and switches the profile to Hermes' Docker terminal backend, where denied paths are absent from the container.
highlights: Provides a filesystem tree and previews generated Docker mounts.
Applies changes by recreating the container and restarting the gateway.
Includes a real-Docker integration suite for permission modes.

thomasbek3/hermes-bot-kit.summary: Hermes Bot Kit adds desktop plugins that give Hermes Bot Chats an iMessage-style appearance, organize bots into named sections, and display a docked remote-desktop pane. It also includes plugins for preserving task lists in Bot Chats and shaping bot replies like text messages.
highlights: Bubble Mode adds chat bubbles and a typing indicator in Bot Chats.
Computer provides a docked remote-desktop pane and optional agent tools.
Bot Sections and Task Dock add roster organization and task snapshots.

TheSmokeDev/hermes-talk.summary: Hermes Talk is a voice plugin for Hermes Agent that supports interruptible, two-way speech and calls the agent’s tools during a conversation. It runs in the terminal, Discord voice channels, the Hermes dashboard, and Hermes Desktop, with provider support varying by surface.
highlights: Delegates background work and reports results aloud.
Supports OpenAI Realtime, xAI Grok Voice, and Gemini Live.
Dashboard sessions show transcripts and background runs.

Sahil-SS9/hermes-walkie-talkie.summary: Hermes Walkie Talkie is a standalone plugin that lets independent Hermes sessions on the same computer discover one another and coordinate through messages, groups, broadcasts, and structured requests. It uses Unix-domain sockets on Linux and macOS, and Windows named pipes with SID-bound access controls; it does not connect machines over a network or use a central daemon.
highlights: Direct messages include delivery receipts.
Supports named groups and bounded broadcasts.
Includes Hermes tools, slash commands, and an optional Desktop panel.

Sahil-SS9/llm-judge-jury-executioner.summary: A standalone skill and CLI that runs questions through multiple independent models using six protocols, including voting, synthesis, critique, red-team review, and full deliberation. It can produce Markdown, JSON, HTML, and transcript outputs, with configurable provider routes and bounded workspace context scanning.
highlights: Six protocols with fail-closed configuration validation
Outputs verdicts, reports, and phase transcripts
Supports OpenAI-compatible provider APIs

Sahil-SS9/hermes-project-stewardship.summary: Hermes Project Stewardship lets a team of Hermes agents manage a project over time by checking project state, proposing evidence-backed work, waiting for approval where configured, and measuring outcomes. It provides a desktop app with project dashboards, Kanban boards, workflows, planning, approvals, and reports, while keeping projects and tasks in Hermes and storing stewardship data in SQLite.
highlights: Checks project evidence before proposing changes.
Includes project dashboards, Kanban, workflows, and approvals.
Supports per-project autonomy policies and human approval.

MemTensor/memmy-agent.summary: Memmy is a local memory service and agent runtime for carrying project context across AI tools. The README lists integrations including Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes, Cursor, and OpenCode, and describes a desktop app, CLI, and TUI.
highlights: Local Memory Service runs as a user-level systemd service on Linux.
The CLI includes an interactive TUI and model setup wizard.
A separate CLI can connect to the local memory service.

rlaope/oh-my-hermes.summary: oh-my-hermes is an operating layer for Hermes Agent that routes work to skills and model chains by category and can run task graphs in parallel. It also provides reviewed long-term memory, optional language-server tools, and status reporting that distinguishes reported completion from verified work.
highlights: Runs ready task-graph nodes in parallel with separate write scopes.
Routes lanes to configurable model chains and reasoning effort.
Keeps or defers memory candidates with written reasons.

Orkas-AI/Orkas.summary: Orkas is an open-source, local-first desktop app where a Commander coordinates AI agents to complete tasks. Projects retain goals, rules, memory, and files across conversations; to-dos, auto-advance, and scheduled automations help ongoing work proceed for review.
highlights: Includes 16 built-in specialist agents.
Connects to named coding agents and external services.
Offers projects, to-dos, and scheduled automations.

praveen-ks-2001/hermes-agent-template.summary: This Railway template deploys Hermes Agent with a web admin dashboard for configuring providers, channels, and tools, and managing the gateway and user pairing. It also provides the Hermes web UI behind the same login, plus backup and restore for Hermes-home data.
highlights: Configure providers, channels, and tools in a setup wizard
Manage gateway status, logs, and user pairing in the browser
Create and restore backups of Hermes-home data

tutti-os/tutti.summary: Tutti is a shared workspace that connects context, files, apps, and tasks for real-time collaboration. Users can reference conversations and files across agents, and use apps for image generation, UI/UX design, docs, and presentations.
highlights: Connects context, files, apps, and tasks in one workspace
Supports references to conversations, files, app outputs, and tasks
Includes apps for design, documents, presentations, and image generation

iranee/fnos-hermes-agent.summary: Hermes Agent for fnOS is an AI assistant application for Feiniu NAS, deployed through the fnOS app center as an .fpk package. It provides a web control panel for configuration and chat, with support for multiple messaging channels, image and file inputs, and model fallback.
highlights: Web chat supports Markdown and multiple concurrent conversations.
Connects to WeChat, QQ, Feishu, WhatsApp, and Telegram.
Includes a control panel for configuration and status.

silent-reader-cn/hermes-anywhere.summary: Hermes Anywhere is a Flutter and Cupertino client for Hermes Agent, with the same interface and sessions on Windows and Android. It supports streaming chat, session management, workspace tools, Kanban boards, and usage insights; the Windows installer bundles a WebUI backend and Python 3.11 runtime.
highlights: Shared interface and sessions across Windows and Android
Streaming chat with reasoning and tool-call cards
Windows installer includes a WebUI backend and Python runtime

hashgraph-online/hol-guard.summary: HOL Guard is a local-first security layer that reviews AI agent actions, including shell commands, file access, package installs, and MCP tool calls. It can allow, block, or request approval based on policy, and provides a CLI and local dashboard for managing protection and reviewing decision history.
highlights: Screens for secret exposure, destructive operations, and prompt injection.
Tracks local artifacts and reviews tools before launch.
Supports native agent hooks and managed MCP proxies.

rafreid/keryx.summary: Keryx is a live, read-only dashboard for viewing activity recorded by Hermes Agent. It reads the agent’s files and presents them in a 3D force graph, with panels for sessions, tasks, analytics and logs.
highlights: Reads Hermes records without writing to them or contacting the agent.
Updates its panels through a server-sent-events stream.
Supports phone layouts, keyboard controls, light and dark themes.

driftverse/hermes-remote-browser.summary: Hermes Remote Browser lets a Hermes Agent running on a server connect to Chrome on another computer through a browser extension and relay. You choose which tabs to share using a purple Hermes tab group, and browser access is off by default.
highlights: The extension connects outbound; no VPN client or companion app is needed.
Pair browsers with a short code approved on the server.
The extension refuses to read or type into password fields.

ateymoori/pomelu-hermes-plugin.summary: This Hermes plugin routes eligible scheduled messages created from Pomelu chats back to the bot chat, and tells the bot how to message users later. When a bot answers in its Bot Chat, registered phones without Pomelu open receive a push notification with the bot’s name and the start of the answer.
highlights: Routes eligible scheduled messages to bot chat.
Sends pushes when a bot answers in Bot Chat.
Supports registering phones with Hermes.

ateymoori/pomelu.summary: Pomelu is an open-source mobile app for connecting to a self-hosted Hermes Agent gateway from Android and Apple devices. It provides chat with bots, supports media and files, and includes features such as approvals, notifications, and Bot Screen control on supported Linux gateway hosts.
highlights: One chat per Hermes bot, with live answers and tool activity
Send and receive voice, photos, video, and files
Bot Screen supports watching and taking over a bot’s Linux desktop

apelabs-dev/hermes-mock-review.summary: mock-review is a Hermes plugin for reviewing UI and design options through shareable review boards. Reviewers can approve, request changes, or skip decisions, add notes and pins, then send feedback that wakes the agent in the originating chat. Boards display mocks at desktop, tablet, and phone widths in light and dark modes.
highlights: Review boards support decision marks, notes, and pinned comments.
Sending feedback wakes the agent in the originating chat.
Boards render mocks at three widths and in light and dark modes.

apelabs-dev/hermes-finance.summary: hermes-finance is a self-hosted personal-finance dashboard that stores account, balance, and transaction data in a local SQLite file. It supports Plaid connections and manual accounts or CSV, OFX, and QFX imports, and tracks spending categories, budgets, bills, goals, loans, investments, and net worth. An AI agent can access the same financial data through native tools, MCP, or the dashboard’s Ask panel.
highlights: Stores financial data in a local SQLite file
Imports CSV, OFX, and QFX files
Provides agent access through native tools and MCP

shbernal/hermes-linkedin-jobsearch.summary: hermes-linkedin-jobsearch is a Hermes profile that searches LinkedIn on a schedule, researches employers, prepares tailored resumes and application answers from your profile facts, and tracks applications. You control what gets sent: Easy Apply requires your instruction by default, while external forms are sent only if you opt in.
highlights: Organizes job discovery by track, with separate queries and fit scoring.
Creates employer dossiers and records shortlist or drop reasons.
Tracks application status from LinkedIn and optionally email.

neolvagentai-lgtm/guide-hermes-agent.summary: Guide en français pour installer et configurer Hermes Agent, le relier à un modèle d’IA et à une messagerie, puis le faire tourner sur un serveur. Il couvre aussi des pratiques de sécurité et les coûts possibles, et renvoie à la documentation officielle pour les détails à jour.
highlights: Présente les commandes d’installation pour Linux, macOS, WSL2 et Windows natif.
Explique la configuration du modèle et de la passerelle de messagerie.
Donne des conseils de sécurité et de déploiement sur un serveur.

faxforagents/hermes-integration.summary: Fax for Agents for Hermes Agent provides a workflow skill and MCP configuration for sending and receiving faxes with approval controls. It supports a hosted OAuth connection and a portable stdio setup; the README reports that hosted OAuth was tested with Hermes 0.22.7, while a live stdio connection has not been tested.
highlights: Provides 15 fax-related MCP tools.
Includes a portable skill and stdio configuration.
Hosted OAuth does not require an API key.

shreyas-kamat/iris.summary: Iris is an open-source phone app for connecting to and controlling your own Hermes Agent through its dashboard. It supports chat, voice calls, conversation management, and server features such as scheduled jobs and tasks when available; it also includes an offline demo.
highlights: Connects directly to a Hermes dashboard.
Includes chat, voice calls, and conversation controls.
Offers an offline demo with scripted turns.

TechFlipsi/FlipsiBridge.summary: FlipsiBridge connects an Android device to a Hermes server so an AI agent can use device actions such as camera, screen, files, and notifications. It uses an encrypted chat and a self-hosted relay; the phone connects to the relay over WebSocket and can work behind NAT without port forwarding.
highlights: Offers more than 40 device tools.
Chat and media use end-to-end encryption.
Device permissions are opt-in and default to denied.

tubeagentkit/youtube-transcript-hermes-p.summary: This Hermes Agent plugin connects to the GetYouTubeTranscript remote MCP server for transcripts, video search, and channel and playlist browsing. It includes four skills for fetching transcripts, searching YouTube, summarizing videos, and researching channels and playlists.
highlights: MCP tools are read-only.
Transcript fetches use account credits.
The package contains configuration files and Markdown skills.

Med34000/hermes-sanctuary.summary: Hermes Sanctuary is a Hermes plugin that visualizes an agent’s tool activity through Greek mythology characters in a live panorama. It also provides alerts for loops, fallback models, heavy turns, budget overruns and permission requests, plus a daily activity journal, replay and shareable image. The README also describes a standalone server mode with its own chat.
highlights: Available in Hermes Desktop and the web dashboard
Records tool names, times and counts, not conversation content
Includes Olympus and Clearing environments
